[test data] 7_Testing_Observed_Values.csv contains 22 envs (9,486 rows), not the 23 named in the prereg status line: SCH1_2024 appears in the meta, weather and submission-template files but has no observed yields. All 9,486 rows are genotyped hybrids and all 22 envs meet the >= 30 rule. The 2024 test records are the released env x hybrid means, the same unit as the training records (env x hybrid means of plots).

[2024 inputs] No plot-level trait file exists for 2024, so each env's planting date is Date_Planted from 2_Testing_Meta_Data_2024.csv (one value per env) rather than the median plot planting date used for 2014-2023. Weather is 4_Testing_Weather_Data_2024_full_year.csv, which ends on 2024-11-10 (training files run to Dec 31); EC windows that extend past that date are computed from the available days, and their completeness is reported.

[CERIS 2024] With the shorter 2024 weather record, CERIS candidate windows that end beyond an env's last day are undefined for that env and drop out of the leaky (training + 2024) search, but not out of the nested search. The number of finite candidates is reported, and any env whose selected-window prediction is undefined is listed and dropped from the CERIS metric.

[EXT3 re-scoring] 2022 and 2023 enter EXT3 from R9's saved cells (runs/A/out/cells, not refit). Per-env r are read at each protocol's selected index from the saved per-env paths; this is checked against a recomputation from the saved predictions (< 1e-5) and against the R9 per-env CSVs (< 1e-6). The 2024 fold trains on all 2014-2023 records, validates P1 on 2023, and uses leave-one-year-out P3 over 2014-2023.

[models] The 2024 fold reuses R9's v9_lib.run_fold_v9 and exec's R9's v9_run.py helpers verbatim (sha256 checked): the same maturity-lambda rule (P1 year), stage 1 = MG_2k at its P3 lambda in every protocol, cross-fitted HGB residuals with nested cross-fitting for n_iter, D_noEC = PC1..30 + predicted maturity, D_full = + 21 EC_env.

[bootstrap] Every EXT3 statistic resamples envs within each year (2000 draws, seed 20260928, one draw set reused across contrasts). The pooled value is the equal-env-weight mean over the 2022 + 2023 + 2024 envs, with a percentile CI and a one-sided p = (1 + #draws <= 0)/(B + 1). Per-year values use an unstratified bootstrap within that year. The prereg specifies no multiplicity correction, so none is applied.

[G3 pooled] The pooled CERIS optimism is r(leaky) - r(nested) of the env-mean predictions over the pooled 2022-2024 env means, with year-stratified resampling. R9's EXT_pooled CERIS bootstrap was unstratified, so R9's 2022-2023 pooled numbers are not reused.
[compute] The 2024 fold ran on amax (x86_64, egp311) as 1 process x 24 threads; the 2022/2023 folds are R9's amax runs (3 processes x 8 threads). Every setting's folds come from one machine.

[overall_verdict] Mapping declared in r10_summarize.py before the summary was run: GO if D_noEC - MG_2k or D_full - MG_2k is USEFUL on EXT3; WEAK_GO if neither is USEFUL but G2 is CONFIRMED; NO_GO otherwise. MG_98k - MG_2k (G1's third contrast) belongs to track B; this track supplies the record-level MG_2k 2024 predictions for it.
[post-hoc] The new-hybrid subset (test envs with >= 10 hybrids absent from training) is reported as POST-HOC descriptive, following the R9 interpretation; it enters no gate.
